Volusia County Tax Sale – How to Find Great Deals

Thinking about investing in Florida property without breaking the bank?
Volusia County tax sales could be your best move. In this guide, we’ll cover how tax deed auctions and tax certificate sales work in Volusia County and how you can register, bid, and find real estate opportunities.

If you’re serious about investing in tax deeds or buying tax liens in Florida, this article will show you exactly where to start.

Quick Facts: Volusia County Tax Sales

What Is a Tax Deed Sale in Volusia County?

A tax deed sale in Volusia County is a public auction where investors can buy properties when owners fail to pay their property taxes.
When you win at a Volusia County tax deed auction, you are buying full ownership rights. However, you may still need to clear title issues through legal action like a Quiet Title lawsuit.

The properties are sold as-is with no warranties, so it is important to do your research before bidding.

What Is a Tax Certificate Sale in Volusia County?

  • A tax certificate sale usually happens once a year in May.
    Instead of buying the property, you’re buying the tax debt. You earn interest up to 18% when the property owner pays their back taxes.
  • If the owner does not pay within two years, you can apply for a tax deed and eventually take ownership of the property.
  • You can bid at Volusia County’s certificate sales online through LienHub.

How to Participate in Volusia County Tax Deed Auctions

  • Register early at RealAuction before the auction.
  • Research properties listed in the auction. Always check for liens, code violations, and other issues.
  • Prepare your deposit — 5% of your bid or $200, whichever is greater.
  • Bid online during the auction. The highest bidder wins.
  • Pay the full balance by 11:00 AM the next business day.
  • Handle title issues if needed through a Quiet Title Action.

Pro Tip: Many investors miss the importance of title work. Always budget for legal costs after winning a property.

Why Invest in Volusia County Tax Sales?

  • High Potential Returns: Tax certificates can yield up to 18% interest.
  • Affordable Real Estate: Properties often sell below market value.
  • Strong Rental Demand: Daytona Beach, DeLand, and New Smyrna Beach offer profitable rental opportunities.
  • Steady Market Growth: Volusia County’s real estate market keeps growing.
  • Open to Everyone: Both U.S. residents and international buyers can invest.
  • If you’re looking for low-risk real estate investments in Florida, Volusia County is a smart place to start.

Key Attractions and Economic Highlights

  • Popular Attractions: Beaches like Daytona, New Smyrna, and Ormond Beach. Daytona International Speedway and Historic Downtown DeLand.
  • Transportation: Easy access to I-95, I-4 highways, Amtrak rail service, and Daytona Beach International Airport.
  • Economic Growth: Tourism, healthcare, education, and light manufacturing industries are strong.
  • Outdoor Life: Boating, fishing, eco-tourism, and natural springs nearby.

Tips for Success at Volusia County Tax Auctions

  • Study property lists early. Don’t wait until auction day.
  • Attend an auction first without bidding to get familiar.
  • Stick to a budget to avoid overbidding.
  • Plan for Quiet Title if you win a property.

FAQs About Volusia County Tax Sales

Q: Can foreigners invest in Volusia County tax sales?
A: Yes. Volusia County auctions are open to everyone, including international buyers.

Q: What happens if I don’t pay after winning?
A: You lose your deposit and risk being banned from future auctions.

Q: Is title insurance available right after purchase?
A: No. You usually need to complete a Quiet Title Action first.

Q: Where do I find upcoming auction listings?
A: Visit the Volusia Clerk Tax Deeds Page or RealAuction Volusia Site.
